iconGeneration.commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE inventory icon for a 1993 Project Zomboid vehicle-interior furniture mod. Isolated elevated three-quarter isometric view, see top/front/right, orthographic, hand-painted worn game prop with dark precise edges, restrained highlights and fine surface wear, muted believable palette matching existing grey steel cabinet, cardboard box and vinyl bus-seat icons. Object fully visible, centered with padding, genuine transparent background, no floor, no shadow outside object, no writing, no logos, no UI, no border. Should remain legible as a 64x64 game inventory icon.

Center full object with padding. Genuine transparent background, no floor, no outside shadow, no text, no logos, no UI, no border.

radioAdapter.purpose: Show the actual stored Base.HamRadio1 upright on the service workbench; no furniture or inventory item added
radioAdapter.tool: image_gen.imagegen concept; Blender 3.6 geometry and existing painted material bake
radioAdapter.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a single asset design reference for a compact early-1990s tabletop HAM radio transceiver for a Project Zomboid style vehicle interior. It must match the existing muted painted 3D furniture art: worn grey steel, almost-black rubber and faceplate, softened bevels, subtle grime, small dull green frequency display, one large black tuning knob, three smaller round knobs, short horizontal speaker grille, simple top carry handle, short rear whip antenna. Broad box proportions: 36 cm wide, 24 cm deep, 24 cm case height with antenna reaching 40 cm. The radio stands upright on four little rubber feet. Three quarter isometric front view from above, camera sees front and right side and top; fully visible on neutral warm grey background, no extra objects, no labels or readable typography, no branding, no glowing sci-fi elements. Low-detail believable game prop, hand-painted subdued material texture with softly lit top and darker side, no outlines. This is a Blender construction reference for the actual radio already stored on a service workbench, not furniture and not a separate new inventory item.
radioAdapter.nativeModelFallback: Only when Base.HamRadio1 has no native model; other mods and future native model declarations take precedence
radioAdapter.orientationCorrection: Radio mesh faces the aisle; all original inventory IDs and packing bounds retained
